items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-03-22
items.q: Now, Herman Sherman, you remember Herman Sherman? No, he died. He died. But he was one of these that was always in somebody's marching band.

ctx.x: Did you hear any brass bands on a carnival day? Well yeah, well you know, what happened, you would always hear some, there'll always be some

little marching club with a brass band. And I'm talking about blacks. There was always a band coming along the street, somebody playing, you really don't know who they are. But there's always a, you would always hear marching band. Now, Herman Sherman, you remember Herman Sherman? No, he died. He died. But he was one of these that was always in somebody's marching band.
